title: Terminal Mux: AgentMonitor, drivers, session log conversion
description:
Implement terminal mux drivers and monitoring from docs/plans/09-h2-termmux-port.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §6 (AgentMonitor — state machine), §7 (TermmuxDriverAdapter), §8 (Claude Code driver), §9 (Codex driver), §10 (session log conversion)

Key deliverables:
- AgentMonitor: agent state machine (Active/Idle/Exited with sub-states), state inference from events, health checks
- TermmuxDriverAdapter: bridges termmux sessions to AgentDriver interface — implements Start/Resume/Stop/Subscribe
- Claude Code driver: launch claude-code CLI in PTY, parse OTEL events + hook events, map to AgentEvents
- Codex driver: launch codex CLI in PTY, parse session log JSONL, map to AgentEvents
- Bidirectional session log conversion: JSONL ↔ internal event format
- Unit tests for AgentMonitor state machine, TermmuxDriverAdapter, driver-specific event parsing, session log round-trip

Depends on: Terminal Mux core task for SessionManager, VirtualTerminal, event normalization.
See Implementation Guide §1.4: NativeDriver is in internal/agent/loop.go. 3rd-party driver adapters go in internal/agent/driver_claudecode.go and driver_codex.go.
